pricing.title: Simple, transparent pricing
pricing.subtitle: Everything you need to manage your transfer business.
pricing.planDesc: No credit card required. Start in minutes.
pricing.feature3: Customer portal with unique shareable link
pricing.feature5: Pickup details: driver, meeting point, time
pricing.feature7: Email notifications to admin and customer
pricing.faqDesc: The free plan covers everything a transfer company needs to run day-to-day operations. Paid tiers with advanced features may be introduced in the future — existing users will always be notified in advance.

landing.heroSubtitle: dantrip.com collects your customers' requests in one place — professional quotes, fast confirmations, zero disorganization.
landing.trustLabel: Trusted by transport companies across Europe
landing.spotlight1Title: A branded portal your customers will actually use
landing.spotlight1Desc: Give every customer a seamless booking experience. They submit transfer requests in minutes — no account required, no friction.
landing.spotlight1Point1: Branded portal with your logo and cover photo
landing.spotlight1Point2: Works on any device, any language
landing.spotlight2Desc: Build and send detailed quotations with pricing, car seat info, and custom notes. Customers accept or reject in one click from their inbox.
landing.spotlight2Point1: One-click accept or reject for customers
landing.spotlight2Point2: Include price, extras, and custom terms
landing.spotlight3Title: Keep every conversation in one place
landing.spotlight3Desc: No more lost emails or WhatsApp threads. Chat directly with customers inside each request and get notified on every update.
landing.spotlight3Point3: Admin and customer views in sync
landing.featuresSubtitle: From the first quote request to the final confirmation — fully covered.
landing.feature1Desc: Customers submit transfer requests directly through your branded booking portal — no account required.
landing.feature2Desc: Draft, review, and send quotes with pricing, car seat info, and custom terms. Customers accept or reject in one click.
landing.feature3Desc: Admins get notified on every new request. Customers are emailed when their quote is ready or their booking is confirmed.
landing.feature4Desc: Chat directly with customers inside each request. No more lost emails or WhatsApp threads.
landing.feature5Desc: Available in English and Italian. Serve international customers effortlessly.
landing.feature6Desc: Assign a driver to each transfer and automatically send pickup instructions to the customer — time, location, and driver name.
landing.stepsSubtitle: A simple, fast flow from request to confirmed transfer.
landing.step1Desc: They fill in pickup, destination, passenger details and submit — getting a unique link to track their request.
landing.step2Desc: Review the request, create a quotation with pricing and extras, and send it to the customer with one click.
landing.step3Desc: The customer accepts, provides pickup details, and you confirm. Everyone gets notified automatically.
landing.ctaBannerSubtitle: Sign in to your account and start managing requests in minutes.
